### Why Bananas Can Help

- **Potassium:** Alcohol increases urination and vomiting can deplete fluids, causing you to lose electrolytes like potassium. One medium banana provides about 9% of your daily potassium value.
- **Gentle on the stomach:** Bananas are bland and easy to digest, making them less likely to trigger nausea than greasy or acidic foods.
- **Quick energy:** Natural sugars and carbs help raise low blood sugar that can contribute to fatigue and weakness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXX6ChbKLY85Xf6PX-03zEqjmdcvhXfEGKK-2oac6Djk86PNe_qUXiuxfDWX6fNmzIS4Azwc8Xl4qy__u-DDec2dCzwaVVXkf4Y3cbSEK7ugsYXqc7m_IFpCLGsmwiUU5e3DkinFJ8bDNySj1s5Up8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1-iMjlOiM1tS0o1CI7vbB0TmNjfp6bI1erhPD-JhH80nRe8ktL617JDlLsNbgMf7Fgk88MhtatTEcmtxzO3uXB7oZd4wO3CzODBHGWka4LoCR61bIVAEJfyZGkFMFwFipua_y6dQiUftbCQneeUBc7gzGd_luNkgT1eVcndAM7EXIw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXmXSCepfOAEtnVgNgAk7nhX8PJ49b-_HReofMk7xQwXpQGX-ynZO7WRpIxkJZwkP0FLp8gjWEwJ7l_GB64t2bbH9XG1olKJGqlIgtGxkGfpf0dYYs0BzXf6YIPVfdSP8oPwP4tBAB8v12qXngY8R3pw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXDYDW_V7zXQGT_lnaSAvwzVbjRPlVVv88NNVq7PZJ_jQx2FSXnPUNBSsNSCwfFx8E9tqOOjMwkcYZPikxtWR0aRgVrcEmZ5XaTYiz4EZygiU5CNFZXTciFmj8CnlvyPNadE7eCYUkyE9CYrlzLyOc-pMUlbZT)

### Practical Tips

- Pair a banana with water or an electrolyte drink (like coconut water or an oral rehydration solution) to address dehydration.
- For broader ideas on what to eat or avoid, see [GoodRx](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1-iMjlOiM1tS0o1CI7vbB0TmNjfp6bI1erhPD-JhH80nRe8ktL617JDlLsNbgMf7Fgk88MhtatTEcmtxzO3uXB7oZd4wO3CzODBHGWka4LoCR61bIVAEJfyZGkFMFwFipua_y6dQiUftbCQneeUBc7gzGd_luNkgT1eVcndAM7EXIw) for hangover food guidance and [BBC](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF18PNx8ieBDVtzzjs6F1dfRxEHqcNwZtiG3CXGfGZ-VoKvsQXlZ41PXcH78jyiiO2C6cYo3DjpivNKc8G-RMedbRMUKpSSxQxPn8AYxtioFAHwtggxyR_NQizyws6uWxWlchGkLlByh-WCx7hqHJxIxhLMb4Hs9boQCwepipidIMk7eD9CKhtISRK_DUv) for a look at the science behind hangover remedies.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF18PNx8ieBDVtzzjs6F1dfRxEHqcNwZtiG3CXGfGZ-VoKvsQXlZ41PXcH78jyiiO2C6cYo3DjpivNKc8G-RMedbRMUKpSSxQxPn8AYxtioFAHwtggxyR_NQizyws6uWxWlchGkLlByh-WCx7hqHJxIxhLMb4Hs9boQCwepipidIMk7eD9CKhtISRK_DUv)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1-iMjlOiM1tS0o1CI7vbB0TmNjfp6bI1erhPD-JhH80nRe8ktL617JDlLsNbgMf7Fgk88MhtatTEcmtxzO3uXB7oZd4wO3CzODBHGWka4LoCR61bIVAEJfyZGkFMFwFipua_y6dQiUftbCQneeUBc7gzGd_luNkgT1eVcndAM7EXIw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXX6ChbKLY85Xf6PX-03zEqjmdcvhXfEGKK-2oac6Djk86PNe_qUXiuxfDWX6fNmzIS4Azwc8Xl4qy__u-DDec2dCzwaVVXkf4Y3cbSEK7ugsYXqc7m_IFpCLGsmwiUU5e3DkinFJ8bDNySj1s5Up8)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXmXSCepfOAEtnVgNgAk7nhX8PJ49b-_HReofMk7xQwXpQGX-ynZO7WRpIxkJZwkP0FLp8gjWEwJ7l_GB64t2bbH9XG1olKJGqlIgtGxkGfpf0dYYs0BzXf6YIPVfdSP8oPwP4tBAB8v12qXngY8R3pw)
